AND business_id = '{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.business_id }}'
AND active = true

SELECT start_time, end_time
FROM availability_rules
WHERE professional_id = '{{ $('busca de profissional').item.json.id }}'
AND day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM (
  '{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.data_consulta_reuniao }}'::timestamptz 
  AT TIME ZONE '{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.timezone }}'
))
AND active = true;

SELECT scheduled_at, ends_at
FROM appointments
WHERE professional_id = '{{ $('busca de profissional').item.json.id }}'
AND DATE(scheduled_at::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE '{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.timezone }}') = DATE('{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.data_consulta_reuniao }}'::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE '{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.timezone }}')
AND status NOT IN ('cancelled_by_client', 'cancelled_by_business', 'cancelled_auto')
ORDER BY scheduled_at ASC;

  COALESCE(ps.custom_duration_min, s.duration_min) AS duration_min

SELECT 
  a.id,
  a.scheduled_at,
  a.ends_at,
  p.name as profissional,
  s.name as servico
FROM appointments a
JOIN professionals p ON a.professional_id = p.id
JOIN services s ON a.service_id = s.id
WHERE a.client_id = '{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.client_id }}'
AND a.business_id = '{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.business_id }}'
AND a.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
AND a.scheduled_at > now()
ORDER BY a.scheduled_at ASC;
